tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// rtogs ldan rgyan po'i dris lan bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de na sgom byed kyin gnas pa'i rtogs ldan rgyan po zhes bya ba zhig gi chos rje pa la bskor ba dang phyag mang po byed cing 'dug pa la/ chos rje pa'i zhal nas/ rtogs ldan pa bskor phyag kyang ngo mtshar che ste/ gnas 'di 'dra na 'dug pa la gdams ngag zab mo la brten pa'i sgom sgrub cig dgos pa yin te ang gsung gin 'dug rtogs ldan pa des bsam mno zhig btang ste rang gi gnas nas dar yug dkar po zhig blangs te chos rje pa la phul nas/ chos rje pa lta ba phyag rgya chen po 'di theg pa thams cad kyi bsgom du bzhed dam/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin ji lta bu lags/ ci'i phyir phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/ 'di'i skye tshul dang*/ sa lam bgrod tshul gyi rim pa ji lta bu lags/ bdag la phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag zab mo zhig gnang bar zhu zhes zhu yin 'dug pa la/ chos rje pa thugs dges te/ ḍoṃ bi pa'i kye rdo rje'i dbang bskur mdzad nas/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes grub dang*/ tog tse ba'i bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag tshad ma gcig gnang nas/ nged kyi lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i khrid lugs 'di ltar yin/ grub thob ma snga bar rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa mdzod dang mi bslu bar yong*/ khyod kyis dris pa'i don mdor bsdus pa 'di rnams thugs la zhog gsungs nas/ spyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lugs la lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lugs la zab gsal gnyis med kyi rgyas 'debs par bshad kyang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad ma gsungs shing de dag gi lugs la mchog gi dngos grub bshad kyang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ma bshad pas/

lta ba phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa bsgom par mi 'dod do// de dag gi lugs la rtogs bya stong pa nyid zab mo bshad kyang*/ rtogs byed thabs lam zab mo ma bshad pas phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa mi 'thad pa yin/ dper na nyan thos kyi lugs la sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa bshad kyang*/ grogs thabs shes khyad par can ma bshad pas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa mi 'thad pa bzhin/ mi blun po la ba lang du 'dogs pa ltar/ de dag gi lta ba'i bsgom la phyag rgya chen por 'dogs pa ni ming tsam la mi brtsad/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin ni// phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde// gzung dang 'dzin pa dbyibs dag dang*// rtog dang brjod pa rnam par spangs// dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang*// pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can// rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab bdag /e waṃ yi ge de la 'dud// phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ pra phab pa yi rnam pa can// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// phyag rgya chen po de la 'dud// ces gsungs pa ltar rtogs bya chos nyid gnyug ma zhes bya ba rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid de/ rtogs tshul smra bsam brjod med kyi nyams pra phab pa'i rnam pa can gyi sgo nas rtogs bya'i ngo bor rnal 'byor zung 'jug gi ye shes de yang snang stong zung 'jug rig stong zung 'jug bde stong zung 'jug bde chen zung 'jug lhan skyes ye shes/ rang byung ye shes/ rang gi ye shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa de rtogs pa'i thabs/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ bla ma legs par mnyes byas te// yang dag dbang bskur rab mnos nas/ de nyid don ni rab tu dbye// zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ phyi nas de nyid rab tu dbye// zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi dbang bskur mtshan nyid pa dang*/

grol byed kyi rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa tshul bzhin du bsgoms pa las 'byung ba yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos bstan pa// rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten// gcig ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ste// gzhan ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin// zhes gsang sngags bla med kyi ye shes 'dren pa'i thabs thams cad rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas bshad pa'i gnad de yin no// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba'i sgra don ni/ legs sbyar gi skad la ma sbyangs pa dag phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te// rgya ni 'khor ba'i rgya las grol// zhes gsar rnying dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le sogs las 'byung zhes smra ba ni 'khrul pa ste/ legs sbyar gyi skad la ma hā mu drā zhes pa ni/ bod skad du mahā chen po/ 'dir phyag gi skad dod med pa la rgyal pos bkas bcad kyi dbang gis/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis phyag zhes pa'i tshig bod skad la bsnan pa yin/ dper na bha ga wa te zhes pa la 'das pa'i skad dod med pa la bod skad la 'das zhes pa'i tshig bsnan pa bzhin no// des na 'dir rgyud las phyag gi bshad pa 'ong don med pa la phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te/ zhes pa bod kyis byas pa'i brdzus ma yin/ phyag rgya chen po thig le sogs la tshig 'di dag med/ mu drā rgya dang*/ rtags dang*/ mtshan ma dang*/ gug skyed la sogs pa la 'jug pa las/ 'dir rgya ru bsgyur ba yin no// don ni a wa dhū tī pas/ rgyas gdab phyir na rgya zhes te// srid gsum ro gcig phyag chen po// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bde stong zung 'jug ngang du rgyas btab nas nyams su len pa'i don gyi lta ba phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yin no// skye tshul gyi rim pa ni/ gang zag skal bzang 'ga' zhig la dbang gi ye shes 'bebs pa'i dus nas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa skye ba yang yod mod/

phal che ba ni thabs bsgom pa sogs la ltos shing*/ thog mar phyag rgya chen po ltar snang skyes nas/ phyis phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po ltar snang zhes bya ba yang cha mthun pa dug can dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa skyon can gnyis 'byung ba yin/ dug can ni thos bsam gyis bsdus pa'i go rtogs dang*/ bsgoms byung gis bsdus pa rnam rtog gi rba rlabs ma yal bzhin du zung 'jug gi nyams ban bun skyes pa yin/ 'ba' zhig pa ni gnas pa 'ba' zhig pa dang*/ so sor rtog pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang*/ snang phyogs 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang*/ stong phyogs 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang*/ lus la bde drod dang*/ 'phar g.yo dang*/ ngag la nges med kyi smra brjod dang*/ sems la nges pa med pa'i ting 'dzin gyi nyams snang sna tshogs pa ste sgo gsum gyi nyams 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang*/ brgyal ba dang tshogs drug 'gags pa la sogs pa'i nyi tshe ba 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa rnams yin/ sa lam bgrod tshul ni/ byang chub don du gnyer bas smin byed dbang bskur nas brtsams te nyams skyon can rnams rdzogs pa yan chad theg pa thun mong pa ltar na tshogs lam zhes bya ba yin/ brtag gnyis las/ kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes shing*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyun chags su 'byung yang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags phra mo dang bcas pa nam langs nas nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i dpe'i ye shes rgyu la skyes pa ni sbyor ba'i lam zhes bya ba yin te/ mtshan brjod las/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das// ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang ba// rnam par rtog med lhun gyi grub// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa phyag rgya chen po don gyi ye shes thog mar skyes pa'i tshe na mthong ba'i lam thob pa zhes bya ba yin/

de rgyun chags su goms shing gong nas gong du bgrod de sa bcu gnyis pa'i bar du phyin pa ni sgom pa'i lam zhes bya ba yin/ de nas sa bcu gsum mngon du byas pa na sku bzhi ye shes lnga la sogs pa yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu thob pa ni mi slob lam mngon sum du byas pa'o// de yang thun mong ba ltar na sbyor lam/ thun mong ma yin pa ltar na phyag rgya chen po dpe'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes nas don gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa dang*/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe 'dir mngon du byed par 'dod na/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i spyod pa dang*/ nye rgyu sogs tshul bzhin du nyams len byas na/ rgya gar gyi grub thob rnams ltar tshe 'dir 'grub pa las 'os ci yod/ dpe'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes nas spyod pa ma grub na 'da' ka ma dang*/ bar do'i gdams ngag gis 'grub par bshad/ 'ga' zhig gis/ phyag rgya chen po chig chod la// sa lam rtsi ba'i rmongs pa 'khrul// zhes bya ba ni 'khrul pa ste/ mtshan brjod las/ mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste// zhes bya ba dang*/ a bhi dha na las/ rab tu dga' dang dri ma med// de bzhin 'od byed 'od 'phro dang*// shin tu sbyangs dka' mngon du gyur// ring du song dang mi g.yo ba// legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin// dpe med pa dang ye shes che// rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum pa// zhes sogs rgyud sde dang grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis sa lam gyi rnam gzhag rgya cher mdzad pa'i phyir ro// mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa lam bgrod pa'i tha ma la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul yin/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

sems kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i gnas tshul mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas sa lam bgrod de 'tshang rgya ba la dgongs pa yin/ ji skad du/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam// phyi rol gyur pa yod ma yin// zhes pa dang*/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad sems su ro gcig pa'i gnad kyis yin/ rtogs ldan khyed kyis 'di dag thugs la zhog la sgrub pa mdzod dang*/ phan thogs pa chen po gcig 'ong gsungs nas ched gnyer mdzad cing 'dug rtogs ldan rgyan po la gdams pa phyag rgya chen po'i mig thur zhes bya ba chos rje pa'i gsungs la yang yang nan chags byas nas bi jis ri bo rtse lngar bris pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
